title: Font Manager web font subset presets
description: The named character sets a web font export can keep (latin, cyrillic, ...). Each is a list of CSS unicode-range values.

source.description: Where the ranges come from: the Google Fonts CSS whose unicode-range splits they copy.

name.description: The name a request uses (latin-ext): lower case letters and digits, words joined by '-'.

ranges.description: CSS unicode-range values: U+XXXX, U+XXXX-YYYY or U+4?? (hex in upper case, at most 10FFFF, first at most last).
